channel.description: The DeepSeek API uses an API format compatible with OpenAI/Anthropic. By modifying the configuration, you can use the OpenAI/Anthropic SDK or softwares compatible with the OpenAI/Anthropic API to access the DeepSeek API.

image.title: Your First API Call | DeepSeek API Docs

item.description:
To meet the demand for using the Anthropic API ecosystem, our API has added support for the Anthropic API format, with the base_url being https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic.

With simple configuration, you can integrate the capabilities of DeepSeek into the Anthropic API ecosystem.

Use DeepSeek in Claude Code​

Please refer to Integrate with Claude Code.

item.description:
The deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp model accepts images alongside text, so you can ask the model to describe pictures, read text from screenshots, analyze charts, and more.

Supported image formats: JPEG, PNG, GIF, and WebP.
